lanes.name: Physics & Materials
lanes.description: Metallurgy, materials science, and applied energy research — the Collegium's foundation for stronger hulls, sharper instruments, and eventually megastructure-grade construction.

lanes.name: Logistics & Industry
lanes.description: Freight efficiency, propulsion doctrine, and forge-complex automation — the study of moving and making things faster, cheaper, and with less waste.

lanes.name: Biology & Colonization
lanes.description: Life support, habitat design, and survey method — the science of keeping people alive off-world and turning a surveyed rock into a functioning settlement.

lanes.name: Military Doctrine
lanes.description: Weapon systems, defense grids, and fleet doctrine — research that keeps the Directorate's ships intact and its enemies from staying that way.

nodes.name: Refined Alloy Process
nodes.flavor_text: The Collegium's metallurgists formalize a slower but purer smelting rite, wringing more usable alloy from every load of ore.

nodes.name: Stress Lattice Theory
nodes.flavor_text: A mathematical model of load-bearing lattices lets shipwrights reinforce a hull without adding dead weight.

nodes.name: Focused Energy Emitters
nodes.flavor_text: Coherent-emission theory, if it can be tamed into a stable housing, promises weapons that do not miss.

nodes.name: Megastructure-Grade Materials
nodes.flavor_text: A material standard rated for structures that will never fly — built instead to endure in place for centuries, a first requirement for hive and Dyson-scale work.

nodes.name: Cargo Hold Optimization
nodes.flavor_text: Redesigned bracing frees hold volume aboard freighters like the CSV Meridian without touching hull dimensions.

nodes.name: Fuel Reclamation Cycles
nodes.flavor_text: Recovering waste heat and unburned reactant from drive exhaust stretches every tank of fuel further.

nodes.name: Star-Lane Transit Doctrine
nodes.flavor_text: The Collegium standardizes navigation along established corridors: slower to leave them, but far cheaper and safer while on them.

nodes.name: Open-Space Drive Doctrine
nodes.flavor_text: An alternative doctrine that accepts higher fuel burn off the star-lanes in exchange for freedom of movement — scouting, interception, and reaching worlds no corridor touches.

nodes.name: Automated Forge Scheduling
nodes.flavor_text: A scheduling doctrine that lets Mars's forge complexes run automation policy on production queues, freeing overseers for exceptions rather than every order.

nodes.name: Closed-Loop Life Support
nodes.flavor_text: Recycled air, water, and waste stretch every shipment of support supplies further before the next freighter is due.

nodes.name: Standardized Survey Protocols
nodes.flavor_text: A fixed survey checklist replaces ad hoc scouting, cutting the time from arrival to a founded outpost.

nodes.name: Modular Habitat Construction
nodes.flavor_text: Prefabricated habitat sections snap together on-site, letting a colony's population cap grow without a full rebuild.

nodes.name: Agroforge Cultivation Methods
nodes.flavor_text: Controlled-environment cultivation domes make a surveyed world viable as a dedicated agri-world.

nodes.name: Point Defense Grids
nodes.flavor_text: Automated point-defense batteries intercept incoming fire before it reaches the hull.

nodes.name: Kinetic Mass Drivers
nodes.flavor_text: A brute-force doctrine: hurl mass at high velocity. Cheaper to build and maintain than a beam weapon, and just as final.

nodes.name: Salvage Field Recovery Doctrine
nodes.flavor_text: Standardized recovery procedure for wreck fields: what looked like scrap starts yielding intact components and data cores.

nodes.name: Escort Doctrine Hardening
nodes.flavor_text: Lessons pulled from recovered wrecks harden the doctrine for the Directorate's first dedicated escort hulls.

nodes.name: Freighter Mark II Hull Design
nodes.flavor_text: A revised freighter hull pattern, superseding the CSV Meridian's Mark I baseline with a wider cargo frame and thicker plating.

nodes.name: Light Warship Mark II Hull Design
nodes.flavor_text: Reinforced weapon mounts and armor plating for the light warship line, superseding the Mark I baseline.
